deficits.suggestion: Construct a continuous footway along the left side to provide a safe pedestrian route.
Construct a continuous footway along the right side to provide a safe pedestrian route.
Install a signalised pedestrian crossing at this junction to improve safety for pedestrians crossing the road.
Add a pedestrian refuge island at the crossing to provide a safe place for pedestrians to wait when crossing a two-lane road.
Install dropped kerbs at the crossing to improve accessibility for pedestrians and wheelchair users.
Install street lighting along this urban road to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians and drivers at night.
